settings.sweep.title: Session branches
settings.sweep.body: Every session branch in a repository with a checkout here, with what it holds. Cleaning up removes those whose work is on a branch of yours, or that hold nothing, with their trees. Commits no branch of yours holds, uncommitted work, and a tree a session still uses are kept: a failed or superseded attempt's commits go only when you discard its branch, which asks first.

settings.sweep.discardSays_other: Discards `{{branch}}` in {{repository}}, and with it {{count}} commits no branch of yours holds. Nothing brings them back.
settings.sweep.discardSaysTree: Discards `{{branch}}` in {{repository}} and its tree, and with them {{count}} commit no branch of yours holds. Nothing brings it back.
settings.sweep.discardSaysTree_other: Discards `{{branch}}` in {{repository}} and its tree, and with them {{count}} commits no branch of yours holds. Nothing brings them back.
settings.sweep.none: No session branches in any repository with a checkout here.

settings.sweep.landed.title: Landed branches
settings.sweep.landed.body: A landing put each one's work on a branch, and a squash merge of its pull request leaves git calling it unmerged. Each goes once every file it changed reads on the line as it left it, or it is inside another that does. Only branches a landing made here are listed: your own are never judged.
